variants.name: ValidationErrors
variants.summary: Create ticket pressed with gaps: Requester and Description are empty and a CC entry is not an email address, so each turns invalid with its message under it and focus moves to Requester; the typed Subject stays.

variants.name: ContactError
variants.summary: Add new contact chosen and Create ticket pressed: Contact email holds an address with no domain ending and turns invalid, Subject and Description are empty and invalid too, and Search contacts goes back to the contact search.

variants.name: Submitting
variants.summary: A filled ticket in flight: Create ticket spins, every field, Cancel and Create and add another are disabled until the answer comes back.

variants.name: SubmitError
variants.summary: The request failed: a danger Alert above the save bar says the ticket wasn't created, with Retry, and every value stays as entered.

variants.name: Success
variants.summary: After Create and add another: a success toast names Ticket #4840 with Open ticket, and the form is empty again with focus on Requester.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The contacts, groups and agents are still arriving: skeleton rows hold the three bands and both create buttons are disabled.
